name: Supine Hamstring Stretch

instructions.description: Lie on your back with one leg straight on the floor and the other leg lifted.
Hold behind the thigh or calf of the lifted leg while keeping the knee slightly bent if needed.
Gently draw the leg toward you until you feel a stretch in the back of the thigh.
Breathe steadily, hold the position, then lower the leg and switch sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Hold each side at a mild to moderate stretch intensity.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Stretch from a seated position if lying down is not practical.

commentsNotes: Do not force the knee fully straight if the back of the leg feels too sharp.
Keep the pelvis neutral rather than lifting it off the mat.
